prompt: RimWorld game building sprite, seen from directly above: a scavenged automated gun turret salvaged from a derelict starship, a squat square emplacement wrapped in a battered slab of curved ballistic plating bolted crudely in front, a short twin-barrel gun mount poking out past the plate edge. Weathered dark alloy hull, exposed cabling, rivets, scorch marks, muted amber status light. Ancient-salvage look: old, patched, industrial, matte. One centred object filling most of a square canvas. Not a creature, not organic, no shell or body shapes.
style_notes: Painted RimWorld building sprite, single image, transparent background, no ground shadow. Dark weathered alloy, rust and scorch, muted amber lighting. Owned design, same register as the old-line turret and other ancient salvage.
